Qualify the reviewed Ferocity token receiver under the unchanged bounded gates

Bind the unspent source08 browser attempt and original 27-stage priority gate to the complete receiving source. Preserve all four browser cases, zero retries, the original 508-case bank, every frozen experimental input, and earlier failed and accepted component evidence.

Receive canonical token-defender and entry-event provenance fixes only after their original 16 plus separate four cases passed and root independently accepted the raw artifact. Preserve Ferocity current combat and Gift behavior. Root independently accepted the receiving source; Izzet independently accepted the final browser and 210-source priority binding. Sphinx independently reviewed the read-only runtime relocation helper. These are named non-author agent reviews, not GitHub approvals.

Exactly one next push from d097 may execute source08. Later evidence commits and workflow reruns cannot consume another browser attempt. Full receiving CI, actual artifacts, complete runtime/admission and the original first 16 D2 games remain separate; no official game, outcome or calibration allocation is consumed by this commit.

Published tree is byte-identical to local reviewed assembly f31effad6c64b01f2100f9c97e296265a11f8687 (tree 56c6b8dd46dc112cdb70db496fd9d0c3e915e8a6). The intermediate local review identities remain source candidates documented by exact file hashes.
